name: Doorman Trainer
tagline: Door, door, cart, gone. Drill Doorman's kidnap until it's automatic.
summary: A solo trainer for Doorman's kidnap: place door 1 by your team, drop door 2 in the fight and cart an enemy through it. Bots walk, dodge and fight back.
description: Doorman Trainer by BeeeFX teaches the kidnap one try at a time. Each try starts at a Guardian, a Walker or the Mid-Boss pit. Place door 1 and the fight begins. Drop door 2 between you and the enemies, then Luggage Cart someone through. If you miss, the trainer tells you why: no second door, the cart missed, or you dragged them past the door. Climb a ten-level ladder from a target standing still to a full teamfight, survive Endless waves against the clock, or hold the real Mid-Boss while the enemy team takes it. Practice lets you set your own enemies, allies, heroes and difficulty. Your build comes ready, Vortex Web included.
goal: Kidnap the enemy through your doors

howToPlay.title: Door 1 by your team
howToPlay.body: You start at a tower. Place your first door with Doorway; the fight starts the moment it is down.

howToPlay.title: Door 2, then the cart
howToPlay.body: Drop the second door between you and the enemies, then Luggage Cart one of them back through it.

howToPlay.title: Read the result
howToPlay.body: A kidnap counts as soon as they come out of your door. Tap Reload to retry the same setup or Jump for the next one. Type /dt for the menu.

facts.label: Spots
facts.value: Every Guardian, Walker and the pit
